name: Conservation agriculture (minimum disturbance, cover, rotation)

soft_risks.risk: FAO records crop yield decreases under conservation agriculture in some semi-arid regions
soft_risks.mitigation: Introduce the three components in sequence rather than at once, starting with residue cover

soft_risks.risk: The permanent soil cover component competes with fodder use of residues
soft_risks.mitigation: Retain a partial cover and source fodder from a dedicated strip

mechanism: Minimum disturbance, permanent soil cover and crop rotation act together so carbon accumulates while the surface stays protected.
